text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“And now, the day has finally arrived for 
the ultimate grand finale of the year, the 
Arima Kinen!”

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"In the spirit of our year-end roundup, 
today we'd like to ask everyone: what is 
the most memorable race you have ever 
witnessed?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"For me... it was last week's Make Debut, 
yes."

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?! The Make Debut...?! Not a G1 or an 
overseas race...?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway... it made an immense impact on 
me. Though her debut came late, she was an 
Umamusume blessed with overwhelming 
power."

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"I truly felt she is a hero of the next 
generation. That is precisely why—"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"May today's Arima Kinen overwrite those 
memories... and prove that we won't go 
down without a fight, either."

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text: "—I'm looking forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I can hear the cheering all the way 
from the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...It's been a long road to get here, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Before I met you, Trainer, I had no 
confidence in myself and was just spinning 
my wheels for a long time."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Back in the Junior Class, I kept chasing 
after Kris S-san even though I couldn't 
catch up... and that gave me courage, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Back in my Classic Year, I wanted to 
catch up to Kris S-san so badly, wanted 
her to look my way, clinging on to her so 
pathetically..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The reason I clung so desperately to the 
word 'hero' this year was also—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's all part of the "Heroic Tale"... and 
it is our story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Every part of the story we spun together 
is what allows me... to stand here today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Will you hold onto this 
'heroic tale' for me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to watch the climax of this 
story... from the very front lines, and 
write it down for me."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Please. ...Um, you see, well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Because I had a narrator like you... this 
story's protagonist never had to walk a 
lonely journey, not even once.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for being here with me. 
That's why, today—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Please stay the closest to me. And 
please wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —My triumphant return!
choice_data_list: Got it. Leave it to me.
Got it. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Shall we head off, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Claiming the final crown of the "Senior 
Autumn Triple Crown"—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Onto the stage of battle to become a 
universally recognized hero!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh...! This is bad, this is bad! The 
Arima Kinen is finally starting!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Is Zenno Rob Roy really gonna pull it 
off...! The second in history to achieve 
the "Autumn Senior Triple Crown"!! I've 
been so excited, I barely slept last 
night!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know. Having such an 
incredible rival show up at this point, 
it's like... Actually, no, it just gets me 
even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, there's no way... Rumors were even 
spreading that she had already retired—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
To think that THE Symboli Kris S would 
step up here!!
(WOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
L-Listen to this tremendous roar from the 
crowd! The paddock at Nakayama Racecourse 
is absolutely shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will the late-blooming hero seize the 
victory?! Or will the Jet-Black Emperor 
stand in her way?! Expectations are 
soaring for this legendary showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes. What is it, Kris S-san?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —She's strong.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I know it well. Since long ago... 
better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So—!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I will crush you completely! Right 
here, right now, I will defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Today as well, you're shining 
brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's a duel. —Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The light. —Just how strong... is yours?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: âShow me.
